correction: AGENTS.md said upstream dracut-ng 'as of 2026-08' still lacked 90-image-dissect.rules in 01systemd-udevd, and that systemd 261 moved the gpt-auto symlink rules. Both were wrong. Upstream renumbered the module to 11systemd-udevd on 2025-06-30. dracut-ng 108 (2025-08-04) has installed 90-image-dissect.rules there since commit fa17b6fb0e. That commit attributes the rule split to systemd v258; snosi first saw it on the Trixie 257 -> Forky 261 jump. The drop-in is still required only because the images use Trixie's dracut 106.
